errors.text: The claim that L12 ordering suppresses conventional stacking-fault energy to near zero is not supported by the cited evidence and conflates intrinsic SFE with ordered-phase fault energetics such as SISFE and APBE.

The proposed evidence base does not directly validate ordering, APBE, or the ductile-brittle-ductile transition in aged AlCoCrFeNi2.1; most citations concern different alloy systems or calculated phase stability.
